title: 23 Songs From 2016 That Are Somehow A Decade Old Already
text:
Prepare to feel very nostalgic today.
music. It honestly feels like it was just yesterday. We were blasting these songs on the radio, adding them to every Spotify playlist, and convincing ourselves that we would stay youngBut alas, here we are.
Somehow these iconic hits are officially turning 10 years old this year! Whether they topped the charts, dominated social media years later, or still live rent-free in your brain, these songs are guaranteed to make you feel at least a"Okay, ladies / Now let's get in formation / Prove to me you got some coordination / Slay trick, or you get eliminated .
""I know you're always on the night shift / But I can't stand these nights alone / And I don't need no explanation / 'Cause, baby, you're the boss at home. " "That girl is a real crowd pleaser / Small world, all her friends know me / Young bull livin' like an old geezer / Quick release the cash, watch it fall slowly .
""You and me got a whole lot of history / We could be the greatest team / That the world has ever seen. " "I got that sunshine in my pocket / Got that good soul in my feet / I feel that hot blood in my body when it drops. ""All of the downs and the uppers / Keep making love to each other / And I'm trying, trying, I'm trying / But I...Can't keep my hands to myself.
""Tell me, why are we wasting time on all your wasted cryin' / When you should be with me instead? / I know I can treat you better, better than he can.
" :"That's why I need a one dance / Got a Hennessy in my hand / One more time 'fore I go / Higher powers taking a hold on me. ""Don't wanna know / Kind of dress you're wearing tonight / If he's holding onto you so tight / The way I did before.
""Send my love to your new lover / Treat her better / We've gotta let go of all of our ghosts / We both know we ain't kids no more. ""I took a pill in Ibiza to show Avicii I was cool / And when I finally got sober, felt 10 years older / But f- it, it was something to do.
""She tells him,"Ooh, love / No one's ever gonna hurt you, love" /"I'm gonna give you all of my love" /"Nobody matters like you" . " Which of these songs still has a permanent spot on your playlist? What's your favourite song from 2016? Let us know in the comments down below! 🎶✨
